items.html: And on the second day of Rosh HaShanah, all the Gevura part of his Keter remains in her Keter; and the rest of the Gevurot that departed on the first day from his Hochma, Bina, Daat, and HGT descend and stand in her Hochma. And then the first section of the Netzah of ZA is sawed, and also the Hochma in the female standing opposite it; and all the Gevurot in his Hochma and below descend into her Hochma, which was sawed on this day. And behold, at the time of the descent of these Gevurot into her Hochma, they are sweetened a second time more, for indeed the second day of Rosh HaShanah is called "soft judgment" (Dina Rafya).
